           FROM expense_ledger e
          WHERE ((auth.uid() IS NOT NULL) AND (e.company_id = private.get_current_user_company_id()) AND (private.get_current_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::text, 'admin'::text, 'accounts'::text])))
        )
 SELECT ledger.id AS expense_id,
    ledger.company_id,
    ledger.expense_number,
    'total_component_mismatch'::text AS issue,
    ledger.total_amount AS stored_value,
    round((((ledger.base_amount + ledger.tax_amount) + ledger.freight_amount) - ledger.discount_amount), 2) AS expected_value
   FROM ledger
  WHERE (ledger.total_amount <> round((((ledger.base_amount + ledger.tax_amount) + ledger.freight_amount) - ledger.discount_amount), 2))
UNION ALL
 SELECT ledger.id AS expense_id,
    ledger.company_id,
    ledger.expense_number,
    'paid_projection_mismatch'::text AS issue,
    ledger.amount_paid AS stored_value,
    ledger.ledger_paid AS expected_value
   FROM ledger
  WHERE (ledger.amount_paid <> ledger.ledger_paid)
UNION ALL
 SELECT ledger.id AS expense_id,
    ledger.company_id,
    ledger.expense_number,
    'settlement_exceeds_total'::text AS issue,
    ledger.total_amount AS stored_value,
    ((ledger.ledger_paid - ledger.ledger_refunded) + ledger.ledger_credited) AS expected_value
   FROM ledger
  WHERE (((ledger.ledger_paid - ledger.ledger_refunded) > ledger.total_amount) OR (ledger.ledger_credited > ledger.total_amount))
UNION ALL

    0 AS expected_value

  WHERE (((ledger.ledger_paid - ledger.ledger_refunded) > (0)::numeric) AND (ledger.approval_status <> 'approved'::text))
